column1: # ADR-006: model assets are NOT bundled with this repository. Their licences
# differ from the code's, so acquisition is a separate, attributable step that
# the operator performs knowingly with `oo models fetch`.
# Every entry is checksummed. A file already present with a matching digest is
# never re-downloaded, so a Pi on a metered or intermittent link touches the
# network exactly once. A digest mismatch is a hard failure, never a warning.
# Classifier: 1x144000 float32 in (3 s @ 48 kHz), 1x6522 logits out.
# Code is Apache-2.0; these released model assets are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
# Mirrored from BirdNET-Go, which vendors Cornell's released checkpoints.
# Range ("MData") model: (latitude, longitude, week) -> per-species occurrence
# probability. This is what turns "sounds like species X" into "species X is
# Labels, en_uk common names, in model output order.
